paite: Amoz tapa Isaiin Judate leh Jerusalem tungtang thu a muh.
english: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

paite: Ni nanungte ah hichi ahi dinga, TOUPA in omna tang tuh tang lian tung te ah hihkipin a om dinga, tangneu khakhate tungah leng tawisanin a om ding; huailaiah nam chihte tuh a hoh juajua ding uhi.
english: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.

paite: Huan, chi tampite a hoh ding ua, Hongpai unla, TOUPA tangah, Jakob Pathian in ah, i hohtou ding uh; huchiin aman a lamte tanchinte a honsinsak dinga, a lampite ah ia ai ding, a chi ding uh; Zion akipanin dan thu lah a hongpawt sin ngala, TOUPA thu Jerusalem akipanin a hongpawt sin hi.
english: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For out of Zion the law shall go forth, and the word of Yahweh from Jerusalem.

paite: Huan, aman nam chih laka vai a hawm dinga, chi tampi tak leng a taihilh ding: huan, a temsaute uh leilahna muksum dingin a sek ding uh: nam dangin nam dang tungah tamsau a likta kei dinga, kidou dan leng a kisinta kei ding uhi.
english: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

paite: Jakob inkuanpihte aw, hongpai un TOUPA vakah i vak ding uh.
english: House of Jacob, come, and let us walk in the light of Yahweh.

paite: Suahlam akipana dan hongpawttea a nadim ua, Philistiate banga aisansiamte a hih ua, gam dang mite tate toh khut a kilet jiak un, Na mi, Jakob inkuanpihte, lah na paisanta ngala.
english: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.

paite: A gam uh dangka leh dangkaengin a dima, a sumte uhlah simseng vual ahi kei; a gam uh sakolin a dima, a kangtalaite ulah simseng vual ahi kei.
english: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

paite: A gam uh milimin a dima; a khut ua a sep khiak uh, a khutzungte ua a bawl uh, a be sek uhi.
english: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

paite: Mi neute hihniamin a om ua, mi liante leng niamsakin a om uh: huaijiakin amau ngaidam ken.
english: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.

paite: TOUPA kihtakhuaina akipan leh a kilawmna thupina akipan suangpi ah lut unla, leivui ah bu un.
english: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.

paite: Mihing kideihnate hihniamin a om dinga, mite kisaktheihna niamsakin a om ding, huai niin TOUPA kia tawisanin a om ding hi.
english: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the haughtiness of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.

paite: Sepaihte TOUPA ni lah kingaisang leh kisathei tengteng tungah leh tawisanga om tengteng tungah a om sin ngala; huchiin, niamsakin a om ding uh:
english: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and haughty, and for all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low:

paite: Lebanon tanga sidar sing sang pipite leh tawisanga om tengteng tungah, Bashan gama tosaw tengteng tungah,
english: For all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,

paite: Tang lian sangpipite tungah, tang neu tawisanga om tengteng tungah,
english: For all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,

paite: In sang sangpipite tungah, kulh bang tengteng tungah
english: For every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,

paite: Tarsish long lian tengteng tungah, thil lim deihhuai tengteng tungah leng hong om sin hi.
english: For all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.

paite: Mihing kideihnate hihniamin a om dinga, mite kisaktheihna niamsakin a om ding. Huainiin TOUPA kia tawisangin a om ding.
english: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be exalted in that day.

paite: Huan, milimte a mang vengveng ding hi.
english: The idols shall utterly pass away.

paite: Huan, lei nakpipi-a lingsak dinga a thoh hun chiangin, TOUPA kihtakhuaina akipan leh a kilawmna thupina a kipanin mite suangpi hawmte leh lei kohawmte ah a lut ding uh.
english: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

paite: Huai niin miten a dangka milimte uleh a dangkaeng milimte uh, biak dinga a bawlsak uh, buite leh bakte kiangah a pai ding uh;
english: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver, and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

paite: Lei nakpipi-a lingsak dinga a thoh hun chiangin, TOUPA kihtakhuaina akipan leh a kilawmna thupian akipanin, suangpihawmte leh kawl suangpi hawmte ah a lut ding uh.A nak vang ua hu om mihing muan tawpsanta un: Banglamah ahia muan tak a hih mahmah?
english: To go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

paite: A nak vang ua hu om mihing muan tawpsanta un: Banglamah ahia muan tak a hih mahmah?
english: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?
